thread:
tasha: FYI — need a quick sync. We're cutting a minimal base image with patched glibc for svc-graphql. A couple of RBAC/KMS questions before we flip the canary. KMS rotation happened last week so want to avoid signing failures.

omar: Can you paste the image tag and the signer KMS URI? Also which service account runs the bake job?

tasha: image: gcr.redwood.com/platform/svc-graphql:2026-03-20-patch. Baker SA: ci-image-baker@infra. Intended signer URI: kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/img-signer/cryptoKeyVersions/3

deepak: If the baker SA lost access after rotation, cosign will fail with something like 'rpc error: permission denied'. Two quick mitigations:
1) ensure a key-scoped IAM binding for the baker SA rather than broad project roles
2) add a dry-run cosign step in CI before the full bake canary.

Sample CI snippets:
```
cosign sign --kms ${KMS_URI} ${IMAGE}

gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding img-signer \
  --keyring=kr --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-image-baker@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner
```

sec-oncall: +1 to the dry-run. Also recommend an audit alert during the canary window for cosign/sign failures (filter on methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign" and our key resource). Add rollback steps to the runbook too.

omar: On RBAC: prefer binding roles at the cryptoKey resource level. Quick note — which role exactly? cosign with asymmetric KMS expects signer capability, so roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner or the older signerVerifier name, depending on key type. I'll verify and patch the CI if needed.

deepak: Confirmed: for our RSA-PSS asymmetric key we need the signer role. If someone accidentally gave Encrypter/Decrypter only, signing will fail. Also decide if we allow a short-lived delegation role (temp role) for the bake window instead of permanent binding.

tasha: Good catch. Compliance question: we need audit logs retained >=90 days. What's our current retention for admin/audit logs? If shorter we'll export to a GCS bucket.

sec-oncall: Default admin logs are 30d. Standard approach: export KMS audit logs to logs-archive GCS for 365d. I'll add that to the checklist. Also add a small canary playbook:
- pre-check: IAM binding on key (key-level)
- pre-check: cosign dry-run
- pre-check: log export enabled
- canary: 5% traffic for 1h
- monitor: auth/sign errors, image pull errors, latency spikes
- rollback: kube rollout undo + revoke new tag if signing failed

jenkins-bot: deploy:ci-image-baker started canary bake for svc-graphql sha256:abcd1234 -> tag 2026-03-20-patch (canary 5%). Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/12345 :white_check_mark:

omar: If cosign dry-run exits non-zero, the pipeline should auto-abort and trigger rollback. Add a guardian check to the pipeline: if $COSIGN_EXIT != 0 then fail and notify #eng-oncall.

tasha: I'll update the pipeline and the IAM binding. Plan: add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner for ci-image-baker scoped to img-signer key, enable log export to logs-archive, and run a dry-run immediately. Ping me if you want to join the 10:30 handoff. Thanks everyone :pray:
